description: Use this when the person wants to see, open or change a plan by hand, or wants to watch you build it. Shows a plan in the Simple House Planner editor, where the person can change it by hand in 2D and 3D and sees your changes as you make them. Without a project ID it shows their plans to choose from. Each call opens another editor, and an open editor follows every change by itself: call this once for a plan, and again only to show another plan or when the person asks to open it again.

project_id.description: The project's ID from list_projects or create_project. It is an internal key: people know their plans by title.

name: open_editor
